content.short: Safeheron provides open-source MPC & TEE-based asset self-custody for institutions.
content.description: Safeheron delivers comprehensive self-custody solutions for institutions, putting clients in full control of their private keys and assets. By removing single points of failure—from a single private key, a single person, or a single device—the platform enhances security and efficiency. Institutions can leverage Safeheron WaaS to access standard MPC wallets for co-managed assets, or integrate Safeheron APIs and SDKs to build their own MPC wallets. Privatization options are available to tailor built-in MPC wallets to the needs of customers and their users.
content.meta: Safeheron is an open-source MPC & TEE-based asset self-custody platform for institutions. Discover Safeheron and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: 594.5 BTC Gone: When Trusted Hardware Fails
resources.tldr: Around 500 addresses drained in a short window, 1,324 UTXOs in total. A careful write-up of what happens when the hardware you trusted turns out to be the weakness.

resources.title: The Triple-A Attack and a Review of July's Security Incidents
resources.tldr: A month of failures collected in one place, starting with a treasury breach. Reading incidents in aggregate reveals patterns that individual post-mortems miss.
